#PCA
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(factoextra)
df<-read_xlsx("PCA.xlsx")
df<-t(df)
dfGroup<-read_xlsx("abcd.xlsx")
pca_result <- prcomp(df,scale=T)
p<-fviz_pca_ind(pca_result,ellipse.level=0.9,col.ind = dfGroup$group,palette = c("#00AFBB","#E7B800","#FC4E07","#cC4E07"),addEllipses = TRUE,ellipse.type="confidence")
#ellipse.type = "confidence"为置信椭圆，没加cofidence为浓度椭圆
             legend.title = "Groups"
p
#volcano
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(readxl)
dataset<-read_xlsx("TMT Msm profiling.xlsx")
df<-dataset
df$group<-ifelse(df$fc>=1.2&df$P<=0.05,"up",ifelse(df$fc<=0.83&df$P<=0.05,"Down","Not sig"))
df$fc<-log2(df$fc)
p<-ggplot(df,aes(x=fc,y=-log10(P )))+
geom_point(aes(color=group))+
scale_color_manual(values=c("#546de5", "#d2dae2","#ff4757")) +
theme_bw() +
theme(panel.grid=element_blank())+
geom_vline(xintercept=c(log2(0.83),log2(1.2)),lty=4,col="gray",lwd=0.8) +
geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),lty=4,col="gray",lwd=0.8)
p
table(df$group)

groupFile="A0QY29 hotmap group.txt"

ann <- read.table(groupFile, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
p <- pheatmap(rt,
              annotation = ann,
              cluster_cols = TRUE,
              cluster_rows = TRUE,
              color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(50),
              show_colnames = TRUE, 
              show_rownames = TRUE,
              scale = "row", 
              fontsize = 8, 
              fontsize_row = 6, 
              fontsize_col = 6,
              border_color = NA)
pdf(outFile, width = 6, height = 5.5)
print(p)
dev.off()
#Sankey Diagram
library(tidyverse)
library(ggsankeyfier)
library(patchwork)
library(RColorBrewer)

 df <- read_tsv("sankey.txt",
 col_types = cols(
 metamplites = col_character(),
 pathNames = col_character(),   # 指定为字符型
 count = col_double()           # 指定为数值型
 )
 ) %>%
 separate_rows(metamplites, convert = TRUE, sep = "/")
                                                                
dff <- df %>% select(metamplites,pathNames,count) %>%
 pivot_stages_longer(
 stages_from=c("metamplites","pathNames"),
 values_from = "count")
 col <- c(unique(df$pathNames), df$metamplites) %>% as_tibble() %>% 
     bind_cols(color = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Set1"))(nrow(.))) %>% 
     deframe()     #颜色随机
p1 <- ggplot(data=dff,aes(x=stage,y=count,
                    group = node,
                    edge_id = edge_id,
                    connector = connector)) + # 定义节点之间的连接方
# 绘制桑基图的边
  geom_sankeyedge(
    position=position_sankey(order="ascending",
                             v_space = "auto", # 自动计算节点之间的垂直间距
                             width = 0.05)) +
# 绘制桑基图的节点
  geom_sankeynode(aes(fill=node,color=node),
    position=position_sankey(
      order="ascending",v_space="auto",width=0.05)) +
  geom_text(data=dff %>% filter(connector== "from"),
            aes(label=node),stat="sankeynode",
            position=position_sankey(
              v_space="auto",order="ascending",nudge_x=-0.05),
            hjust=1,size=2.8,color="black") +
# 添加右侧文本标签设置位置偏移 0.05
  geom_text(data = dff %>% filter(connector== "to"),
            aes(label=node),stat="sankeynode",
            position=position_sankey(
              v_space="auto",order="ascending",nudge_x=-0.05),
            hjust=1,size=2.8,color="black") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult=c(0.01,0))) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=col) +
  scale_color_manual(values=col) +
  labs(x=NULL,y=NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,5,unit="cm"))
print（P1）

气泡图：
library(ggplot2)
set.seed(123) # 设置随机数种子以保证结果可复现

KEGG_Pathway <- c(
    "Riboflavin metabolism",
 "Homologous recombination",
    "DNA replication",
    "Metabolic pathways"
)

# 随机生成 GeneRatio 和 p值
GeneRatio <- runif(4, 0.1, 0.3)
p_value <- c(0.000000384,0.0047,0.0174,0.0124)
counts <- c(181,14,13,12)
y_axis <- c(0.5,1.5,3,6.5)

# 创建数据框 - 修复：在最后一行添加逗号
KEGG_point <- data.frame(
    Pathway = KEGG_Pathway,
    GeneRatio = round(GeneRatio, 2),
    p_value = round(p_value, 4),
    counts = counts,
    y_axis = y_axis
)  # 这里需要换行，不要直接接ggplot代码

# 定义颜色
custom_colors <- c("#5A80BE","#FFC000","red")

# 创建图形 - 修正版本
p1 <- ggplot(KEGG_point, aes(x = y_axis, y = GeneRatio)) +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_point(aes(size = counts, color = -log10(p_value)), shape = 16) + 
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8)) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = custom_colors, name = "-Log10(pvalue)") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "GeneRatio", size = "Count") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(min(KEGG_point$GeneRatio) - 0.02, max(KEGG_point$GeneRatio) + 0.02)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 10), expand = c(0, 0)) +  # 调整x轴范围
  theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12)
  )
print(p1)
ggsave(filename = "合_bubbles_kegg.pdf", plot = p1, height = 4, width = 4)
